frame.name: disk
frame.origin: galaxy.center_kpc (L1/L2 supercluster nexus; L0 centered on box center)
frame.definition: Comoving box Cartesian axes (x, y, z) in physical kpc

order: x-fastest: index = i + n*(j + n*k); voxel centre = -half_kpc + (i + 0.5) * voxel_kpc

webp.map: part p, slice k = 64p + s; pixel (x = (s % 16)*n + i, y = floor(s / 16)*n + j)

gz.star_raw: 4 n^3 bytes RGBA, A = 255 if R|G|B else 0

vx.label: v_x
vx.source: mass-weighted PartType0/Velocities (km/s, a=1) box-frame component x
vx.frame: box (x, y, z), comoving rest frame

vy.label: v_y
vy.source: mass-weighted PartType0/Velocities (km/s, a=1) box-frame component y
vy.frame: box (x, y, z), comoving rest frame

vz.label: v_z
vz.source: mass-weighted PartType0/Velocities (km/s, a=1) box-frame component z
vz.frame: box (x, y, z), comoving rest frame

v.frame: box (x, y, z), comoving rest frame

stars.units: L_AB0 kpc^-3 (L_AB0 = luminosity of an M_AB = 0 source)
stars.photometry: FSPS Chabrier IMF colors.chabrier.dat SDSS i, r, g AB magnitudes
